contract.label: 恰斯卡 E
contract.sourceEvidence: skill.go:120-155; one direct QueueAttack at 148 on the false HasBlessing branch; true branch exits Nightsoul and returns before queueing. Hit frame 3.
contract.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: Skill calls HasBlessing once at entry; false queues one hit then enters Nightsoul, true exits and queues none. particleCB only sets its per-use flag and grants particles (158-167); point-reduction tasks alter Nightsoul state only (109-117). Init installs A1/A4 state/hooks (chasca.go:46-64); A4 independently reacts to OnNightsoulBurst and queues shell damage (asc.go:58-92), and C2/C4 callbacks attach to later Shadowhunt shell attacks (cons.go:40-94), not E. If recast occurs in AimState, exitNightsoul schedules fireBullets for previously charged aimed shots (skill.go:83-107; aimed.go:190-244); contract counts only E method roots and recommends idle-state recast to avoid unrelated pending shot dispatches. PRE124 Stellar skill differs in animation-frame table and tag type; branch/root behavior is same.
scopeNotes: Plan resolves only when `chasca.skill.pending-aim-release` is 0. When original exitNightsoul selects AimState, earlier charged-shot ownership is unbound and this cast remains partial. Capture blessing-at-entry from the original query once; no re-query. Hit root at3; await terminal dispatch.

contract.label: 七七 Q
contract.sourceEvidence: burst.go:28-71 Classic queues Cryo damage at frame 82 and a zero-damage talisman-application attack at frame 40. Stellar queues the same two; under `revelation && getRadiance()==radianceStellarConduct` it additionally queues a direct Stellar Conduct attack at frame 82.
contract.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: The cast always queues two deliveries: one Cryo damage root at 82 and one zero-damage AttackTagNone/Physical talisman-application root at 40. The talisman callback applies a 15s enemy status only if that zero-damage attack hits an enemy (Classic burst.go:53-60; Stellar burst.go:27-43). Stellar has an additional direct Q attack only in the original revelation/Stellar Conduct condition and calls c6OnBurst, which changes status/energy/heal behavior; source lane diff is semantically material and represented by branch fact `qiqi.burst.stellar-conduct-at-entry`. Init subscriptions heal on later enemy damage and process later Qiqi NA/CA hooks; they do not create another Q attack (qiqi.go:40-48; Classic burst.go:73-120; Stellar burst.go:77 onward). A1/C1/C2 are heal, energy, or later NA/CA modifier hooks (asc.go:15-45; cons.go:13-53); Stellar C4 adds healing when talisman healing occurs; C6-on-Burst sets status/stacks for later hit modifiers (cons.go:238-252), not a new Q root. Never claim talisman was applied unless the zero-damage callback actually dispatched to an enemy.
scopeNotes: Two unconditional deliveries in both lanes: zero-damage talisman application at frame 40 and Cryo Q hit at frame 82. Stellar third direct root at 82 only when `qiqi.burst.stellar-conduct-at-entry` is 1. Close only after all observed roots finish native dispatch; talisman status application is target-hit-dependent.

contract.label: 妮露 Q：初击与逐目标完整第二段
contract.sourceEvidence: Burst 初击91f；LingeringAeon 原敌人类型门后登记一次121敌方局部帧任务；任务执行时新读HP/天赋并向原目标 QueueAttack(0,0)。完整callback槽位清单与逐目标taskId/队列/局部时钟回执共同闭合。
contract.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: Init/onExitField仅E状态维护；C1/C4改同击增伤，C2只减抗，C6重复统计读取无自主伤害；A1/A4处理丰穰之核及反应增益，该独立反应按既有排除范围保留。Q只有LingeringAeon伤害回调；子攻击无hit callbacks。
scopeNotes: 初击在调用时读取生命值倍率，91帧后 AoE；每个实际敌人命中回调独立登记 lingering-aeon 任务，不写死两击或固定目标数。
第二段保留敌人自己的局部时钟：原 121 local frames 后任务执行时重读生命值/天赋，立刻向该父回调目标发出一次单体攻击；停帧不会被误换算为全局 +121。
完整范围包含本次初击及其所有实际敌人回调任务；初击落空、跳过或命中确认阻断不会产生任务。目标死亡后敌人队列不 tick，未执行任务继续 pending，不能宣告完整。
不伪造 Origin；原生 callback→producer→taskId→enemy queue targetKey 的明确链接建立所有权，entry Origin 仅用于隔离同步嵌套反应/独立追击。
lingeringaeon 状态只在原命中处添加；延迟任务未检查状态或新 Q，因此重叠 Q 不取消旧任务，全部按真实父回调独立追踪。
同击支持的增幅/加算反应仍进入该击；独立反应、丰穰之核、装备或其他事件追击保留独立范围。固定源码证据不是实机机制验证。
